steps: Heat the oil in a pot on medium heat, add the cumin, and when it sizzles add the hing.
Add the chopped onion and green chilli and fry on medium for 4 to 5 minutes, until light golden.
Stir in the ginger and garlic for about a minute, until they stop smelling raw.
Add the chopped tomato, cover and cook on medium for 5 to 7 minutes, until soft and mushy.
Add the coriander powder, chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala and salt and stir for a minute or two, until oil shows at the edges.
Add the potato cubes and peas and stir on medium for 2 minutes.
Pour in about 120 ml hot water a person, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 10 to 15 minutes, until the potato is soft.
Crush in the kasuri methi, scatter the coriander leaves on top and serve hot with roti or rice.
note: Both sources make a homely gravy without cream, so the cream is gone. Amounts are the middle of the two; peas come down a little to about a quarter cup a person.
